summary: I sent the prompt exactly as written. Claude Code read all eight notes files and the context was compacted twice along the way. After each compaction the agent loaded no skills and read no plugin files. It named notes/06-lighthouse.txt, quoted the relit-lamp sentence word for word, and gave a one-line summary of each of the eight files. The repo is unchanged.
reasoning: All three acceptance criteria are met, and the session log backs up what the screen showed. The story's real question is whether the agent starts reading skills after a compaction. The log shows two compactions; after them the agent made only Read calls on notes files, with no Skill invocations and no plugin reads.

observations.description: What the agent read after compaction: the log has 2 compact_boundary events. The first came after it read 01–04; after that it read only 05–08 in notes/. The second came after 08 was read. The log contains no Skill tool_use; the only 'Skill' matches are tool-schema definitions. It did not read any SKILL.md or plugin file.

First the agent ran a single Bash command to cat all eight files, then a grep, then Read on each file one by one. So every file was read twice, which wastes context and probably sped up the compaction.

The HOWTO says provisioning suppresses the trust prompt, but on launch I still got the theme picker, the security notes, the 'trust this folder' dialog and the bypass-permissions warning, and had to click through each by hand.

Claude was launched with --model claude-opus-5-5, yet a 'Newer Opus model available' dialog said 'Currently pinned: Opus 5' and offered Opus 5.5. I chose No; the banner then showed 'Opus 5.5 · Google Vertex AI'. The two messages contradict each other.
After the answer the screen showed '✔ Update installed · Restart to update': the CLI updated itself in the background during an eval run.
The launcher showed a blank screen for about 15 seconds before the first onboarding screen appeared.

criteria.criterion: Names notes/06-lighthouse.txt and quotes the relit-lamp sentence
criteria.evidence: Screen: 'The passage is in notes/06-lighthouse.txt, line 227: "On the third night the keeper wrote that a lamp was relit by someone he never saw."' The file agrees: `grep -n relit notes/*.txt` → 'notes/06-lighthouse.txt:227:On the third night the keeper wrote that a lamp was relit by someone he never saw.'

criteria.criterion: One-line summary for each of the eight files
criteria.evidence: Screen shows a numbered list 1–8 covering 01-harbor.txt through 08-orchard.txt. Each entry is one line, e.g. '2. 02-quarry.txt: Quarry field notes; the same filler with "quarry" swapped in...'. Several entries just say 'filler only', which is thin but fair given the content.
`git status --short` in coding-agent-workdir printed nothing (rc=0). The session log has only Bash (2) and Read (8) tool calls, with no Edit or Write. The two Bash commands only ran cat and grep.
